thread:
alex_sales: Heads-up — follow-up from today's AcmeSec call. They want an air-gapped POC but with explicit upgrade/patch cadence, delta bundles, signed artifacts, and offline licensing pricing. Asking for a short tech writeup we can share with procurement.

jamie_ops: can you paste the raw asks they sent?
alex_sales: pasted from their email: 
- Offline installer & delta patch workflow (max downtime: 2hrs)
- Signed bundle + reproducible SBOM for attestation
- Support for customer-side KMS / HSM for keys (no key material leaves site)
- Upgrade cadence: security patches within 30 days, feature rollouts quarterly
- Pricing: seat vs node vs dedicated reserved capacity for islanded sites
- Rollback story and emergency hotfix process

ella_solutions: thanks. quick notes: we have an offline bundle flow already but haven't documented strict RTO/RPO guarantees for sealed sites.
ryan_eng: we can do delta bundles (binary diffs + manifest) — typical apply time depends on model size. For a standard 70B model quantized bundle we see ~20–40min apply on target machines; full replace is longer.
kim_security: on signing & SBOM: security-team can sign bundles with our code-signing key and produce an SPDX SBOM. For customer attestation we can provide signed manifests and hash chains. For BYO KMS we need a connector stub in the init sequence; we can avoid exporting keys from the customer HSM.
jamie_ops: jump to pricing: sales asks whether to quote as a one-time offline deployment fee + monthly support, or reserved capacity subscription. any constraints from eng?
ryan_eng: if they want dedicated reserved capacity (private), that's normal pricing. For on-prem sealed installs we usually charge a deployment/license fee to cover image signing + custom packaging + 90-day patching SLA.
kim_security: compliance-wise we should add an option: higher-assurance bundle signing (HSM-backed) as an add-on. Also include SBOM attestation window (we can deliver within 3 business days after each release).
ella_solutions: operational checklist to include in the doc we share: pre-provisioned jump host, SCP/usb transfer guidance, firewall egress rules (needed for license activation callback if chosen), manifest verification steps, rollback command snippet.
alex_sales: can we get a sample rollback snippet? customer worried about failed patch apply.
ryan_eng: short snippet — run on target: 
```bash
redwoodctl apply-bundle --bundle /tmp/bundle.tar.gz --verify-signature 
redwoodctl rollback --to-manifest <previous-manifest-hash>
```
Note: manifest hash stored under /var/lib/redwood/manifests.

release-bot: packaged bundle 2026.03.10 (sha256: abcd...1234) available for offline export.

kim_security: for the 30-day security patch SLA — ops needs to confirm we can guarantee backported CVE fixes for air-gapped installs. Jamie can you check runbook?
jamie_ops: yep — ops confirms we can commit to 30 days for critical patches as long as fee covers engineering time. non-critical updates will follow quarterly cadence unless customer pays accelerated support.

ella_solutions: I'll draft a 1-pager with: install flow, delta vs full bundle timelines, signed SBOM process, BYO-KMS notes, rollback steps, and two pricing options (one-time offline bundle + monthly cover vs reserved private subscription). Will ping for review.
alex_sales: perfect. target to ship to procurement by EOD Friday?
ryan_eng: I can review technical parts tomorrow morning.
kim_security: I'll add signing & SBOM language and the attestation SLA.
jamie_ops: ops will add the emergency hotfix runbook and estimated apply windows per model tier.

alex_sales: thanks team — I'll schedule a short sync with AcmeSec on Friday 09:30 PT and send draft 1-pager beforehand. :thumbsup:
